node.statement: For any n and x, node 1.3 gives ||T_n(x)-v_n(x)||<=D*e||x||, while def-extended-delta-inclusion gives (1-alpha)||x||<=||v_n(x)||<=(1+alpha)||x||. The triangle and reverse-triangle inequalities therefore give ||T_n(x)||<=[1+alpha+D*e]||x||<=[1+(D+1)e]||x|| and ||T_n(x)||>=[1-alpha-D*e]||x||>=[1-(D+1)e]||x||. This is uniform in n and proves the claim with K_N=D+1.
